buildings.name: Königsallee 3
buildings.access_notes: Smart lock system (Nuki). Owner app required. Physical backup key with property manager only. Boiler room key hanging in janitor closet (code: 7743).

incidents.description: Boiler pressure dropped below 0.5 bar overnight. Radiators cold throughout building.
incidents.resolution: Thermo-Fix refilled system and replaced faulty pressure valve. System stable.

incidents.description: Elevator door sensor malfunction. Doors not closing fully. Unit isolated by safety lock.
incidents.resolution: Lift-Service replaced door sensor module and recalibrated alignment.

incidents.description: Burst cold-water pipe in 3rd floor communal bathroom. Water flooding stairwell.
incidents.resolution: Rohr-Blitz isolated supply, replaced 2m of copper pipe, water extraction done.

incidents.description: Main fuse board tripping repeatedly. Affects all apartments on staircase A.
incidents.resolution: Elektro-Schnell replaced overloaded main fuse and upgraded circuit breaker.

incidents.description: Staircase deep clean requested after water damage in INC-003. Mould risk noted.
incidents.resolution: Sauber-Team completed anti-mould treatment and full staircase cleaning.

incidents.description: Gas boiler shut down on safety fault. No heating or hot water. November frost forecast.
incidents.resolution: Bayern Heizung replaced faulty gas valve and heat exchanger. Boiler restarted.

incidents.description: Slow drain in 2nd floor kitchen reported by three tenants.
incidents.resolution: Münchner Sanitär rodded main stack drain, cleared 8m blockage.

incidents.description: External facade lighting (mandatory night safety) failed completely.
incidents.resolution: Strom-Meister replaced wiring and installed LED fixtures with timer relay.

incidents.description: Elevator 1 stuck at floor 4 with occupant inside. Emergency call received.
incidents.resolution: Aufzug-Service Hessen freed occupant in 35 min. Faulty relay board replaced.

incidents.description: Underground parking drain backing up. Risk of flooding lower level.
incidents.resolution: Rhein-Main Sanitär hydro-jetted main drain, removed debris blockage.

incidents.description: Smart meter gateway offline. Building energy monitoring data gap.
incidents.resolution: Elektro-Profi Frankfurt replaced gateway module and reconfigured network.

incidents.description: Three top-floor units report insufficient heating. Radiator valves suspect.
incidents.resolution: Wärme-Technik NRW balanced hydraulic system and replaced 4 thermostat valves.

incidents.description: Nuki smart lock on main entrance failed. Residents locked out.
incidents.resolution: Schlüssel-Profi Berlin replaced lock module and re-paired all resident apps.

incidents.description: Roof terrace lighting circuit failed. Safety issue for evening use.
incidents.resolution: Elektro-Kraft Düsseldorf replaced weatherproof fittings and GFI breaker.

incidents.description: Owner disputes shared-cost allocation for INC-006 boiler repair.
incidents.resolution: Escalated to property manager. Resolution via WEG-owner assembly vote.
